title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten specific Oregon State destinations for gathering, studying, campus resources, and recreation.

cards.title: Memorial Union
cards.subtitle: Central campus gathering spaces and student services
cards.notes: Use the floor plan to find the Main Lounge, Creative Studio, Lanes & Games, meeting rooms, and student-facing offices before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with informal gathering areas, services, and program spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Memorial Union as a campus hub with formal and informal gathering spaces; it houses student services, Lanes & Games, the Creative Studio, restaurants, and lounges.
cards.access_notes: Use the Memorial Union’s posted building information and floor plan; individual rooms and services may have separate access rules.

cards.title: Memorial Union Quad
cards.subtitle: Open lawn between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall
cards.notes: Pause on the lawn between classes, then check the university events calendar for programs scheduled in the quad.
cards.short_summary: A central open-air campus space used for university and student-organization events.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU identifies the MU Quad as a large open space between the Memorial Union and Milam Hall; student organizations and departments may reserve it.
cards.access_notes: The quad is outdoors. Events and reserved uses can affect available space.

cards.title: Student Experience Center Plaza
cards.subtitle: Covered outdoor space between the SEC and Memorial Union
cards.notes: Use this rain-protected plaza as a meeting point along Jefferson Way, and look for student and university events on the calendar.
cards.short_summary: A covered open-air plaza connecting two major student buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU describes the Student Experience Center Plaza as a covered, open-air event space between the Student Experience Center and Memorial Union.
cards.access_notes: The plaza is available to the campus community; reservations may affect use.

cards.title: Valley Library Rotunda
cards.subtitle: The Valley Library’s prominent central study area
cards.notes: Enter the rotunda and check the second, fourth, and fifth-floor nooks for a one-person seat or room for a study partner.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable library study area with smaller seating nooks on upper floors.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature identifies the Valley Library rotunda and its second-, fourth-, and fifth-floor nooks as places to study alone or with a partner.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Valley Library building hours and any posted space-use guidance.

cards.title: Valley Library Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Flexible study area in the Valley Library
cards.notes: Bring a group project or solo task and use the commons’ study seating, desktop computers, scanners, printers, and power-ready setup.
cards.short_summary: A refreshed library area for individual and group work with technology nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU states that the Learning Commons offers individual and group study areas, desktop computers, scanners, and printers; its 2025 refresh was guided by student feedback.
cards.source_title: Popular library study area gets a refresh
cards.access_notes: Use during current Valley Library hours; equipment and seating are subject to availability.

cards.title: Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons support hub in the Valley Library
cards.notes: Pair study time with scheduled help from the Career, Chemistry, Library, Math, Physics, or Writing Center services listed for the CLC.
cards.short_summary: A library-based learning-support location connecting students with several academic services.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Collaborative Learning Center, located in the Learning Commons, offers scheduled assistance from Career, Chemistry, Library, Math, Physics, and Writing Center services.
cards.access_notes: Support is offered during scheduled hours; confirm the relevant service’s current availability before visiting.

cards.title: International Living-Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Study seating near Cascadia Café and Market
cards.notes: Choose this space when you want an active shared atmosphere, then keep food and drink plans separate from study-space expectations.
cards.short_summary: A living-learning building with a social study atmosphere and nearby food options.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature recommends the International Living-Learning Center for studying amid ambient activity and notes nearby Cascadia Café and Market.
cards.access_notes: Observe building signage and current access guidance; café and market purchases are separate.

cards.title: Learning Innovation Center Upper Floors
cards.subtitle: Upper-floor seating with a valley-facing view
cards.notes: Take the elevator or stairs to upper floors and look for open seating when you want to read or work with a view toward Marys Peak.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with upper-floor spots suited to focused reading and project work.
cards.evidence_claim: An OSU student-life feature highlights upper floors of the Learning Innovation Center, including fifth-floor seating with views toward Marys Peak, for reading and projects.
cards.access_notes: Use open seating only and respect classes, events, and posted building access rules.

cards.title: Asian & Pacific Cultural Center
cards.subtitle: 2695 SW Jefferson Way
cards.notes: Visit the lounge or study space, explore the center’s library and resources, and check its programming for ways to connect with the community.
cards.short_summary: A cultural center with lounge, study, quiet-room, kitchen, and library resources.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU says the Asian & Pacific Cultural Center offers a lounge, study space, quiet room, kitchen, computers, library, and engagement opportunities; its resources are open to the OSU community.
cards.access_notes: The center lists resources for students, faculty, staff, and the OSU community; confirm current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Dixon Indoor Climbing Center
cards.subtitle: Inside Dixon Recreation Center
cards.notes: Check current Rec Sports entry requirements, then use the climbing center’s redesigned wall, bouldering area, and accessible belay ledge responsibly.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus climbing facility within Dixon Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: OSU reports that Dixon’s Indoor Climbing Center is open and includes a modern climbing surface, a Kilter Board, and an accessible belay ledge.
cards.access_notes: Rec Sports facility access and participation requirements apply; check current policies and hours before arriving.
